mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average indicates active monetary easing, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint movement of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase does not yield positive 60-day returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high consumer confidence (RSAFS > 700,000), a rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand for housing and related goods, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when HOUST rises and RSAFS > 700,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 in high-confidence regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 3-month moving average indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in rising INDPRO periods.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) fall below 700,000 million dollars for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals policy response to inflation, typically leading to temporary market rally as investors anticipate accommodative measures and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint movement of CPIAUCSL rising and FEDFUNDS falling does not yield positive 20-day returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that increases wage growth and consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in declining UNRATE periods.
